subject.title: fix(macos): reject revoked forwarded exec approvals

question: After the missing script-binding defect is fixed, should approval-requiring legacy nodes without `system.run.prepare` intentionally fail closed before https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103873 lands?
rationale: The stronger remote-identity boundary removes a working fallback and changes existing node behavior, while a separate protected issue owns the capability-parity solution.

options.title: Fail closed now
options.body: Land with a clear capability-upgrade error and accept that approval-required legacy-node runs stop until prepare support is available.

options.title: Wait for prepare parity
options.body: Hold this PR until the Mac node advertises and implements `system.run.prepare`, preserving approval-required workflows.

recommendation.title: Fail closed now
recommendation.body: Land with a clear capability-upgrade error and accept that approval-required legacy-node runs stop until prepare support is available.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged snapshot work and the protected prepare-parity issue establish the strongest ownership trail for this decision.
